# NZ Herald

> > New Zealand's leading digital news platform delivering breaking news, analysis, and comprehensive coverage across politics, business, sports, and lifestyle.

NZ Herald is New Zealand's primary news source, offering real-time coverage of local and international events through multiple formats including live streaming, podcasts, and premium subscription content. The site covers major topics including NZ politics, Auckland and regional news, business markets, sports (particularly rugby and All Blacks), entertainment, and lifestyle content.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- NZ Politics
- New Zealand News
- World News
- Business News
- Sports News
- Local News
- Live Updates
- Auckland
- Christopher Luxon
- Chris Hipkins
- Nicola Willis
- Premium Content
- News Aggregation
- Daily Updates

## Core News Sections

- [NZ Herald Homepage](https://www.nzherald.co.nz): NZ Herald homepage with breaking news, analysis and global coverage
- [Latest News](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/latest-news): Latest news aggregator covering NZ, sport, business, entertainment and world
- [Local & Breaking NZ News](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz): Local and breaking NZ news updates, opinion and insights
- [Politics](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/politics): Political news, analysis and opinion on NZ government and policy
- [Crime News](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/crime): Crime news covering police investigations and court cases in NZ
- [World News](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world): International news and global affairs coverage from NZ Herald

## Video & Broadcast

- [Herald Now Live Stream](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/video/herald-now): Herald Now live news streaming platform hosted by Ryan Bridge
- [News Video Hub](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/video): Video hub with NZ news, weather, sports, business and lifestyle content
- [Podcasts](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/news/podcasts): Podcast directory with news, finance, true crime and parenting content

## Business & Sports

- [Business News](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/business): Business news, market trends, finance updates and economic insights
- [Sports News](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/sport): Sports coverage including rugby, All Blacks, cricket and league news

## Lifestyle & Culture

- [Lifestyle](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/lifestyle): Lifestyle news covering fashion, food, wellness and royal family stories
- [Viva Magazine](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/viva): Viva lifestyle magazine covering fashion, culture, beauty and dining
- [Entertainment](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/entertainment): Entertainment news, celebrity gossip, music and film reviews
- [Travel](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/travel): Travel section with destination guides, tips and reviews for travelers

## Premium & Special Content

- [NZ Herald Premium](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/premium): Premium subscription service with exclusive journalism and in-depth analysis
- [NZ Listener Magazine](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/the-listener): NZ Listener magazine with investigative journalism and opinion content
- [Opinion & Analysis](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/topic/opinion): Opinion columns, editorials, letters and commentary from NZ Herald

## Utilities & Services

- [Weather](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/weather): Weather forecasts and news for New Zealand regions

## Optional

- [Daily Quizzes](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/topic/quizzes): Daily quizzes and trivia covering sports, entertainment and general knowledge
